title: Aircraft Rescue Firefighting in Kandahar
description: B-Roll of 77th Kandahar Air Wing Fire Department members conducting training in Aircraft Rescue Firefighting (ARF) techniques.  Includes footage of the squad suppressing a live fire, fire in an aircraft simulator conex, operations on the airstrip, and gaining emergency procedure familiarization with the wing's Mi-17 helicopters. Sound bites from Pfc. Christopher Minix, Firefighter, 683rd Engineer Detachment and 1LT Mohammed Noor, Fire Chief, 77th Kandahar Air Wing. Available in high definition.
keywords: Kandahar Air Wing, mentorship, ARFF, 683rd Engineer, 438th AEG, NATC, Fire, partnership, firefighters
